text:
The engine of a motor vehicle develops a large power.
Which statement is correct?
A
The driving force acting on the vehicle must be large.
B
The engine must have a very large volume.
C
The engine must transfer large amounts of energy each second.
D
The vehicle must be very fast.

options.label: A
options.text: The driving force acting on the vehicle must be large.

options.label: B
options.text: The engine must have a very large volume.

options.label: C
options.text: The engine must transfer large amounts of energy each second.

options.label: D
options.text: The vehicle must be very fast.
